name: Cats
description: Cats word search puzzles with an unhurried, indoor-evening mood. These free online grids gather soft feline vocabulary — purrs, windowsills, yarn and naps — written for adults who want a quiet puzzle. Easy grids keep words across and down; harder ones add diagonals and reverse words. No timer, no download, no account. Switch on large print when you want bigger letters on phone or tablet.
